data.camera: medium shot, wink and peace sign
data.description: 【星野爱 · 电视录制】音乐番组录影棚里，星野爱一身白上粉下的双色裙装，对着镜头比出偶像手势，紫发间的水晶发饰闪着微光——「电视里的我，也要让大家心跳加速才行呢。」
data.promptProse: Ai faces the music-program camera with a wink and peace sign in her white-and-pink two-tone stage dress and brown belt. Keep the crystal hair ornament among her purple strands. The medium view includes a narrow edge of the camera housing in the foreground, the studio floor beneath her and overlapping scenic panels behind, with a small gap revealing the darker side of the set. Soft studio lamps spread even light across her face, collar and raised fingers. The dress folds retain gentle shadows, and a short soft shadow beneath her feet separates her from the floor without overpowering the highlights in her star-shaped eyes.
data.title: 星野爱 · 电视录制
